verdict.rationale: Pipedrive's own docs say it tracks the sales pipeline and moves opportunities through stages (via its AI assistant). A community user describes it as Trello-like, which implies a visual board-style pipeline that founders used for fundraising. However, the evidence never explicitly documents customizable stages or drag-and-drop deal updates. Missing for 10: first-party documentation of the visual kanban pipeline view, customizable pipeline stages, drag-and-drop deal movement, and hands-on corroboration of those specifics.
